provenance.existing: docs/design-confirmation-brief.md line 45 requires cable length, capacity, connectors, collision and side panel closure to be checked together. The eight cable roles and their length budgets, the eight anchors with coordinates, and the channel graph with capacities all already exist in design/workbench.json and design/workbench-geometry.json. This file only binds each role to the anchors it runs between, which was missing.
provenance.new: The anchor pair for each cable role, and which components a cable connects, are original design work derived from the recorded anchor labels.
provenance.limits: A routing map, not a floor plan. The coordinates, channel shapes and collision volumes remain with the geometry workstream.

rules.everyRoleBound: Every cable role that has a length budget must be bound to a pair of anchors, or its budget can never be checked
rules.endpointsMustExist: Both anchors must exist in every case, or the cable is impossible in that case
rules.pathMustFitBudget: A route through the channel graph must exist and must not exceed the role's length budget
rules.capacityMustSuffice: A channel must be able to carry every cable routed through it
rules.channelCapacityUnit: capacity 的单位是可通过的线缆条数，沿用 workbench-geometry.json 里已有的 24
